summary: Smart Logistics Global Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its annual general meeting of shareholders held on July 10, 2026. Shareholders approved all six proposals, including re-election of directors, ratification of auditor, and a special resolution to re-designate existing shares into a dual-class structure (Class A with 1 vote each, Class B with 50 votes each). No price, premium, or transaction terms are involved. This is a routine corporate governance filing, not a special situation. No deal terms exist.
